summary: Lead review of the final head: session-sync takes its durable upload lease before stamping sentAt/expiresAt and holds it past the cloud's latest commit (expiresAt + max clock skew + slack); batches carry sentAt/expiresAt (schema refine requires both, expiresAt later); clock-skew refusals persist a capped streak with backoff (max 300 s), reported on /status after three, and the gate is rechecked before the legacy rebuild in the same cycle; retries that cannot reach the server before the deadline stop instead of sleeping. Eight rounds of findings closed with red/green proofs; CI proof green on 45579bfc; Codex review of this head clean.
